title: Lost Communication With Automatic Lighting Control Module
plain: Other computers in the car have stopped hearing from the automatic lighting module. It controls some of the vehicle lighting.
symptoms: Headlights or other lights may not work correctly
Lighting warning message possible

causes.name: The automatic lighting module lost power or ground (blown fuse or bad ground)
Damaged, corroded or loose network wiring or connector
Weak battery or low system voltage
Failed automatic lighting module
Another module shorting out the network

checks: Test the battery and charging voltage first
Check the fuses, power and ground for the automatic lighting module
See which modules answer a scan tool to narrow down the break
Inspect network wiring and connectors near the module
fix: Restore power, ground or wiring to the automatic lighting module; replace the module only after those test good.
